description: This file contains unit tests for the hosted client functionality in Orleans. It includes tests for grain calls, timeout behavior, reference equality, observer pattern, and streaming features, all within a test class HostedClientTests.

classes.name: HostedClientTests
classes.description: Test class for verifying Orleans hosted client features such as grain calls, timeouts, reference equality, observers, and streaming.

classes.name: HostedClientTests.Fixture
classes.description: Fixture class for setting up and tearing down the Orleans test cluster environment used in the tests.

methods.name: HostedClient_GrainCallTest
methods.description: Tests basic grain invocation from a hosted client, validating successful communication.

methods.name: HostedClient_TimeoutTest
methods.description: Verifies that response timeouts are enforced and that the runtime correctly tracks requests during timeout scenarios.

methods.name: HostedClient_ReferenceEquality_GrainCallTest
methods.description: Checks reference equality semantics for objects passed through grain calls, including immutable objects, grain references, arrays, and Immutable<T> wrapper.

methods.name: HostedClient_ObserverTest
methods.description: Verifies client registration of observers for grain-based notifications and callback invocation.

methods.name: HostedClient_StreamTest
methods.description: Validates streaming subscription and message reception behavior from Orleans streams.
